h1s.text: 一些想弄明白的问题， 一些动手做出来的东西。

findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "你好，我是佳杰。欢迎来到光怪陆离的小屋" above "一些想弄明白的问题， 一些动手做出来的东西。"; "01 / 重新发明农历" above "如果没有日历，能否从日月运行重新发明一个？"; "02 / 寻找高山" above "海拔最高的山，就是看起来最巍峨的山吗？"; "03 / 现代冰晕研究漫谈" above "天空中的光环，能否从一颗冰晶开始理解？"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: SFMono-Regular — e.g. "FIG. 00", "光 / 时间 / 山川", "几件正在看的东西", "01"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "FIG. 00", "01", "02", "03", "04", "01 / 重新发明农历"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.
Prefer sentence case at body size.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.opening-card.opening-card-halo → rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.6) 0px 14px 24px -20px, rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.25) 0px 2px 5px -3 | a.opening-card.opening-card-celestial → rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.6) 0px 14px 24px -20px, rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.25) 0px 2px 5px -3 | a.opening-card.opening-card-pyramids → rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.6) 0px 14px 24px -20px, rgba(20, 18, 14, 0.25) 0px 2px 5px -3
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 17 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1214px | p.opening-figure-caption 548px | header.section-heading 1214px | figcaption 320px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Cream + terracotta palette (page background #f4efe1, text #faf7ec, text #b03a2e).
findings.fix: Re-draw the palette from the library. This pairing reads as an assistant brand, not yours.

findings.message: Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: Baskerville, SFMono-Regular, Kaiti SC
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 52px (3.6vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("一些想弄明白的问题， 一些动手做出来的东西。") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "一些想弄明白的问题， 一些动手做出来的东西。" → 4 lines (2 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.
